scripts.build: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const isWin=process.platform==='win32'; const cmd=isWin?'npm.cmd':'npm'; spawnSync(cmd, ['run', 'build'], {cwd:'apps/admin', stdio:'inherit'}); spawnSync(cmd, ['run', 'build'], {cwd:'apps/simulator', stdio:'inherit'});"
